learner_starting_state: Has completed L-01-01 and can save and run a small Python file, but may still treat printed text and stored values as the same thing.

mastery_gate: Pass primary and transfer validators at 8 of 8 each, predict both transfer lines before running, and answer all four retrieval items including number-versus-string and assignment-versus-output distinctions.
